desktopReference:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity visual concept for the full Aerotherm corporate homepage, design only, no code.
Primary request: A complete long desktop homepage, straight-on flat screenshot, premium and precise engineering editorial design for a Korean nano-silica aerogel materials R&D company. A very light cool-gray #F6F9FB canvas, white panels, deep navy #102A43 text, graphite #405363 monoline technical icons, protected blue #438CCB, frosted pale-blue aerogel #CCEAF4. Amber-orange-deep red only in technical heat visualizations. Calm, precise, trustworthy; generous white space, strong typographic hierarchy, fine technical hairlines. No stock photos.
Composition: Wide desktop layout, header with AEROTHERM wordmark (spell A E R O T H E R M), About / Technology / Product / Applications / R&D / News / Contact, KO / EN, Contact us. Hero with exact headline "One failing cell should stay one failing cell." Two buttons "Explore our technology" and "Request a sample". Main hero is technical cutaway of FIVE prismatic battery cells stacked broad-face to broad-face: narrow thin ends face camera, camera 25 degrees off narrow-end view and slightly above; each tall brushed metal can has two top terminals. Four extremely thin frosted pale-blue full-height full-width boards sandwiched between broad faces. Center cell glows red, other four blue, fine infrared rays stop at two boards, no flames. Narrow ends approximately quarter of broad face width. Crisp edges on aerogel.
Below hero include all sections in order: About with purpose; Technology with four detailed small scientific panels (nanopores / silica skeleton / radiation blocking / lower conductivity bar chart), matched with-and-without thermal propagation comparison; Product with pale-blue board and spec table with values shown only as em dashes; Applications showing EV pack and ESS rack/container as lab-grade technical cutaways; R&D and quality with lab-testing illustration and placeholder labels for patents and certifications, do not imply any held credentials; News and milestones with three cards, first titled "Founded in October 2026"; Contact with name, company, email, inquiry type, message fields; Footer "Pyeongtaek, Republic of Korea" and "© 2026 Aerotherm".
Typography: clean modern sans serif like Manrope and Inter, readable copy, short headings, elegant quiet technical aesthetic. Hero headline may wrap only if necessary. Long page with complete footer, not a browser/device mockup.
Constraints: use only facts that Aerotherm develops nano-silica aerogel boards between rechargeable EV/ESS battery cells and suppresses thermal radiation as well as convection. Technology numbers only "~70 nm" and "0.011–0.023 W/m·K". Do not invent specifications, test data, certifications, customer logos, claims or statistics. No fires, explosions, dark backgrounds, badges, photos, numerical metrics or giant ornamental type. Exact wordmark.
